name: 中文排版
description: 中英之间该有的那个空格、全角半角混用的标点、重复词、标题 # 后缺的空格 —— 在你打字的当下就在行内画出波浪线,点一下就地改;而不是等发布那一刻才发现全篇几百处。默认永远只画线,一个字都不动:所有改动(单条 / 整段 / 整篇)都由你点出来,并且都进笔记自己的撤销栈,Cmd+Z 能全撤。数据流向:纯本地规则匹配,规则全部写死在代码里,不联网、不调 AI、不枚举全库,你的文字不出这台机器;对笔记的改动全部走编辑器事务(不做「读全文 → 改 → 整篇写回」),唯一会写进笔记库的文件是你主动点「导出报告」时产生的两份体检产物,落在 <工作文件夹>/排版体检/ 下,同名绝不覆写。代码块、行内代码、公式、URL、链接路径、wikilink、HTML 标签与注释、frontmatter 一律豁免 —— 宁可少提示一百次,不可错改一次。
descriptionEn: The missing space between Chinese and Latin text, half-width punctuation inside Chinese sentences, repeated words, a heading whose # has no space after it — zhtypo underlines them inline while you type, and one click fixes the spot. It never edits on its own: every change (one hit, one paragraph, or the whole note) is something you clicked, and all of them go through the note's own undo stack. Where the data goes: pure local rule matching, every rule hard-coded and readable; no network, no AI, no vault-wide scanning — your text never leaves this machine. Edits to a note all go through editor transactions (never read-all-then-write-back). The only files it ever writes into your vault are the two export artifacts you ask for, under <work folder>/排版体检/, and it never overwrites a file of the same name. Code fences, inline code, math, URLs, link targets, wikilinks, HTML tags and comments, and frontmatter are all exempt — better to under-report a hundred times than to wrongly change one character.

onboarding.intro: 中文排版是一支荧光笔,不是自动修改器:装上就在编辑器里画波浪线,一个字都不动,改不改你说了算。

steps.title: 写的时候(零操作)
steps.description: 装上就在笔记里画线:中英之间缺空格、中文句子里的半角逗号、重复词、标题 # 后缺空格、行尾多余空格。点一下波浪线弹出小浮层,「修正 / 忽略这一处 / 关掉这条规则」三个按钮,点哪个都算数,不点就什么也不会发生。

steps.title: 写完一段回头看
steps.description: 命令面板「中文排版:修当前段落」:光标所在那一段里所有可自动修正的问题一次修完,一个事务 = 一次 Cmd+Z 全撤销。名字里的 check 是历史 id,语义就是「修当前段落」。

steps.title: 要发出去之前
steps.description: 命令面板「中文排版:体检当前笔记」,或点状态栏的「排版 N」,打开体检报告:按规则分组的清单,每条给「第 N 行第 M 列」和上下文,点一行跳到编辑器那个位置,或者「一键全修」。

steps.title: 哪些地方它不碰
steps.description: 代码围栏、行内代码、$公式$、URL、[显示](路径) 的路径部分、[[wikilink]]、HTML 标签与注释、frontmatter —— 全部豁免,一个字都不提示、不改。三层豁免并联:只要有一层说豁免就豁免。

steps.title: 旋钮在哪
steps.description: 插件设置页有 6 条规则的开关,加上「单个 # 也当标题」(默认关,因为它和 #标签 长得一样)、「单段字数上限」(超过就跳过不查,免得长文掉帧)、以及导出报告落地的「工作文件夹」。

steps.title: 数据在哪
steps.description: 它不写你的笔记文件:所有改动走编辑器事务。唯一会落盘的是你主动点「导出报告」时产生的两份 —— <工作文件夹>/排版体检/<笔记名>_<时间戳>.md(人看的)与同名点开头的 .json(机器数据)。同名绝不覆写,自动加 -2…-9;报告正开在编辑器里时会直接拒绝导出。

en.intro: zhtypo is a highlighter, not an auto-corrector: once installed it draws squiggles in the editor and changes nothing until you click.

steps.title: While you write (zero setup)
steps.description: Squiggles appear as you type: a missing space between Chinese and Latin text, half-width punctuation inside a Chinese sentence, a repeated word, a heading whose # has no space, trailing whitespace. Click a squiggle for a small popover with Fix / Ignore this one / Turn this rule off. Nothing happens unless you click.

steps.title: After finishing a paragraph
steps.description: Run "zhtypo: Fix current paragraph" from the command palette: every automatically fixable issue in the paragraph holding the caret is fixed in one transaction, so a single Cmd+Z undoes all of it. The command id says "check" for historical reasons — it fixes.

steps.title: Before you publish
steps.description: Run "zhtypo: Check this note", or click "Typo N" in the status bar, to open the report: issues grouped by rule, each with line and column plus context. Click a row to jump to that spot in the editor, or use Fix all.

steps.title: What it never touches
steps.description: Code fences, inline code, $math$, URLs, the target half of [text](path), [[wikilinks]], HTML tags and comments, and frontmatter are all exempt — never reported, never changed. The three exemption layers run in parallel: if any of them says exempt, it is exempt.

steps.title: Where the knobs are
steps.description: The plugin settings page has a switch for each of the six rules, plus "treat a lone # as a heading" (off by default, because it looks exactly like a tag), "max characters per paragraph" (longer ones are skipped so typing stays smooth), and the work folder that exported reports land in.

steps.title: Where the data lives
steps.description: It does not write your note files: every edit goes through an editor transaction. The only things it ever saves are the two artifacts you ask for with Export report — <work folder>/排版体检/<note>_<stamp>.md for humans and a dot-prefixed .json beside it for machines. A name collision never overwrites; it adds -2 through -9, and an export is refused outright while that report is open in the editor.
